topic: Seasonal Demand Forecasting - Tax Season Capacity

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Hi! With tax season approaching, I wanted to check on your bandwidth capacity. Last year you experienced some slowdowns during peak filing periods.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Good timing! We're expecting 30% more clients this year and hired additional preparers. Definitely concerned about network performance.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Based on your growth and our seasonal analytics, I'd recommend temporarily upgrading to 500 Mbps for January through April. We can scale back after tax season.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That flexibility is perfect. What's the cost difference, and can we automate the scaling?
